confirm.title: Disable Unknown Source Tracker
confirm.description:
The Unknown Source Tracker option (`Track unknown power sources`) is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

Use Home Assistant's built-in [Energy dashboard](/config/energy) untracked consumption or a Template sensor instead.

Update any dashboards (including Energy), templates, groups, automations, or scripts that reference the Unknown Source Tracker entities, then select **Submit** to disable the option and remove its entities and device. If energy meters were enabled, any generated utility meter sensors will disappear after restarting Home Assistant.
